newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: United Merchant to buy 33 pct of Malpac.
newsitem.headline: United Merchant to buy 33 pct of Malpac.

text.p: United Merchant Group Bhd said on Saturday it has proposed buying a 32.9 percent stake in Malpac Holdings Bhd to include the stockbroking firm in its range of financial services.
United Merchant said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange through Amanah Merchant Bank Bhd that it would offer 6.75 ringgit for each of the 24.675 million shares up for sale in Malpac.
Bank Negara Malaysia had approved the proposed acquisition on June 19.

It said Malpac was principally involved in investment holdings and financial services, with businesses that include stockbroking, share financing, money lending, nominee services and property holding.

"The proposed acquisition will enable UMG to develop into a fully-integrated financial supermarket with the inclusion of a stockbroking firm into the existing group comprising the UMG group," said UMG.
The company did not explain how it intended to finance the acquisition.
In another related statement to the stock exchange, Amanah Merchant Bank said Advance Synergy Bhd would dispose the entire 50.75 percent stake it held in UMG to its existing shareholders.
The sale was, however, conditional on Advance Synergy chairman Ahmad Sebi Bakar retaining a personal 30 percent stake in Malpac.
